title: Python: Loops
description: Write a Python program that uses for and while loops to print numbers and their squares.

codeTemplate.py:
print("Squares up to 5:")
for i in range(1, 6):
    print(f"{i}^2 = {i * i}")

print("\nCounting down:")
n = 5
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
print("Go!")

hints: `range(start, stop)` generates numbers from start to stop-1
`while` loops continue while a condition is true
